summary: Backend testing for Golden app: 15/15 pytest tests passed against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Covered auth (owner/seed logins, /me, 3-strike lockout + owner unblock + reset-password), user CRUD with owner-only 403 enforcement, warehouse item creation (quantity generates N units each with unique 12-char QR, all in_stock), item listing + QR lookup (200 in_stock, 404 unknown, 409 sold), full sales lifecycle (pending_approval->approve->complete with correct profit/profit_pct/total_cost math, 409 on premature complete, 400 on transfer/debit missing transaction_number, tunai+transfer paths, receipt_no INV-... generation, items marked sold and removed from in_stock query), reject flow, stock-opname weekly/monthly/yearly create+list+approve with owner-only approval, and reports/daily-sales (accounting+owner allowed, warehouse+employee 403) plus reports/summary (owner only, accounting 403). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Accepts reject even when sale is already completed/rejected (no status guard like /approve). Not blocking but inconsistent with approve.
Accepts a `token` query param but never validates it; images are effectively public. Consider verifying JWT if intended to be gated.

action_items: Optional: add status guard to POST /api/sales/{id}/reject (only allow when status == pending_approval).
Optional: enforce auth on GET /api/files/{path} using the token query param, or drop the param.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~640 lines and mixes auth, users, items, sales, opname, reports, and storage in one module; splitting into routers/ files would improve maintainability but is not blocking.

compute_sale_totals uses profit_pct = profit/cost*100 (margin over cost) while reports/summary uses margin = gross_profit/revenue*100 (margin over revenue). Both are valid but the naming is asymmetric; document or unify to avoid downstream confusion.
reset-password flow does not force the user to change on next login (acceptable given owner-only reset, but worth flagging).
receipt_no generation counts completed sales globally then +1; under concurrent completes a duplicate receipt_no is theoretically possible. Consider an atomic counter or unique index on receipt_no.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed users (deleted after each test via soft delete) and TEST_-prefixed items/sales that persist in the DB. Item stock/sales rows are intentionally left to exercise the full lifecycle; they do not affect prod flows and are clearly tagged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated end-to-end against public URL. If frontend testing is requested next, reuse /app/backend/tests/test_golden_api.py as regression. Login body is JSON {username,password} on /api/auth/login (NOT OAuth form). All endpoints prefixed /api. Item QR is uppercase hex[:12]. Sale profit_pct = profit/total_cost*100 (cost-based). Report margin = gross_profit/total_revenue*100 (revenue-based) – difference is by design.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced. All 15 tests pass.
